تقترفوا (form VIII)
# تَقْتَرِفُوا (taqtarifū) /taq.ta.ri.fuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِقْتَرَفَ (iqtarafa)
# تُقْتَرَفُوا (tuqtarafū) /tuq.ta.ra.fuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِقْتَرَفَ (iqtarafa)
